# Career Alerts

> Career Alerts is an India-focused job updates portal with verified freshers jobs, internships, off-campus drives and experienced hiring opportunities from top companies, updated daily.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Latest verified jobs, trending roles, featured companies and categories.
- [Jobs](/jobs): Searchable job listings with filters for category, role, location and experience.
- [About](/about): How Career Alerts curates and verifies job postings.
- [Contact](/contact): Reach the editorial team via email, LinkedIn, X, Instagram and WhatsApp Channel.
